name: Server Ping
description: Browser ping to game hosts: deploys ql-ping-echo (a low-priority WebRTC UDP echo, one shared DTLS certificate) to each enabled host and opens its UDP port in its own firewall chain QLPING-INPUT.

host.label: Run the ping service on this host

global_settings.description: UDP port of ql-ping-echo on every host (1024-65535; reaches a host with Apply on the Server Ping page or its next host setup). The DTLS certificate is generated once on the Server Ping page; its fingerprint goes into the ql-tournament env as PING_DTLS_FINGERPRINT.
